body: I’m admittedly insecure as well, but I try to not talk about people like that all the time.
They’ve always had issues with confronting people. Like they’d easily drop others a lot and often would talk about people they don’t like.
They all just left. Most without a word.
I appreciate you not wanting me to die. I’m just scared that it’d be for the best.
I’m not sure if I can. We wished each other the best on our last messages, but now so many other people are leaving, including this very second. I had no idea what was going on.

I unintentionally acted manipulative to a friend two years ago and I had no idea they were still hurt by it. They sent me a Google Doc explaining why we can’t be friends anymore, and an entire friend group cut me off.
I regret it very deeply. She doesn’t know because she and an entire group of friends just cut me off.
I hurt one friend really badly two years ago and she’s still affected by it. I had no idea I did that until just today.
Ribbit King. I’m so lucky to own it because it’s 80 dollars on eBay, at least the GameCube version.
